title: UInt64 array erase reconstruction
summary: Reconstructs the public representation of an in-bounds Array.eraseIdx! result from its length word, unchanged prefix reads, and one-position-shifted suffix reads.
premises: An erase index below the source array size
Thirty-two-bit and current-memory bounds for the target length word and payload
A target length read equal to the source size minus one
Target prefix reads equal to source reads at the same indices below the erase index
Target suffix reads equal to source reads one element later from the erase index through the result end
result: The target pointer represents input.eraseIdx! erase as an Array UInt64.
